title: Astra Chronicles: Starfall Labyrinth
tagline: Pulled into a brutal 100-floor gacha tower as a disposable 1★ Lv.1 hero—lead a party where fallen allies die for good.
description: Yesterday you were the #1 global tactician in 'Celestia Summons.' Today you woke up on the cold obsidian flagstones of Star Gate Plaza—not as a Master holding the screen, but as a nameless 1★ Lv.1 fodder pull inside a stranger's careless roster. Above the glass sky, an unseen Master treats heroes like disposable gacha currency. Down in the hundred floors of the Starfall Labyrinth, there are no respawns: any heroine who falls in battle shatters into Star Ash forever, and if you die, your run ends on the spot. Armed only with hard-won meta-knowledge up to Floor 40, Star Gate summons in the Main Lobby, and the bonds that awaken low-star misfits past their level caps, clear Floor 100 to break the Covenant and log out alive.
genre: Tactical Gacha-Tower Survival / Dark Fantasy LitRPG / High-Stakes Party Romance
narrationStyle: Tactical Dungeon Survival (Tense, strategic, grounded human grit)
author: Astra Architect

worldContext.settingName: Star Gate Plaza (Floating Lobby Island) & The 100-Floor Starfall Labyrinth
worldContext.eraOrPeriod: Server Cycle 09 — First Deployment After the Blackout Patch
worldContext.loreSummary: Eight immutable Covenant Rules govern the Starfall Labyrinth: (I) Each Master's Main Lobby (Star Gate Plaza) is built atop its own large floating sky-island drifting in an astral sea of starlit clouds around the colossal central 100-Floor Starfall Labyrinth Spire—where neighboring Masters' gilded or crumbling floating islands are visible across the void. All heroes are summoned through the island's Star Gate monolith at rarities 1★ to 5★; summoning is strictly bound to the Floating Lobby Island and locked once deployed inside Labyrinth floors. (II) Hard Star Level Caps restrict growth—1★ caps at Lv.20, 2★ at Lv.30, 3★ at Lv.40, 4★ at Lv.50, and 5★ at Lv.60—discarding excess EXP until promotion. (III) Resonance Awakening (+1★ up to 5★) shatters those caps when a hero forges deep life-or-death trust milestones (25/50/75/90%) or absorbs duplicate Star-Echoes. (IV) Deployment squads hold at most five combatants while benched roster members wait safely on the Floating Lobby Island. (V) Every 25 floors shifts the Spire's entire biome and laws; floors ending in 5 (5, 15, 25, 35…) are neutral Lantern Safe Zones, and every 10th floor (10, 20, 30… 100) is sealed by a lethal Gate Boss. (VI) Fallen heroes NEVER respawn—casualties turn to Star Ash and are etched onto the cliffside Memorial Wall, while protagonist death is an irreversible Game Over. (VII) Beyond the astral glass sky sits an unseen Master issuing Command Seals; defying reckless orders drains Master Trust, while clean clears earn Star Shards. (VIII) Clearing Floor 100 shatters the Administrator's Crown and logs the protagonist out.

factions.name: The Nameless Roster (Star Gate Plaza Survivors)
factions.description: Low-star discards, traumatized scouts, and distrustful high-rarity pulls trapped inside your unseen Master's account. Survival depends on turning a fractured waiting-room of strangers into a disciplined squad that refuses to leave anyone behind.

factions.name: The Crimson Ledger (Rival Master Kaiser Valdane's Vanguard)
factions.description: An elite top-100 speedrunning account led from behind the screen by whale Master Kaiser Valdane and enforced on the floors by his ruthless 5★ champion, Vesper, the Crimson Lancer. They treat 1★–3★ heroes as sacrificial trap-bait to set leaderboard records.

factions.name: The Lantern Brokers (Safe Zone Neutral Guild)
factions.description: Veteran survivors stranded on Floors 5, 15, and 25 whose Masters deleted their apps years ago. Unable to use the Star Gate or climb past dead accounts, they run Safe Zone supply obelisks, repair steel, and trade floor rumors for Star Shards.

factions.name: The Administrator & Covenant Arbiters
factions.description: The cold, faceless system intelligence governing the Starfall Labyrinth. Broadcasts silver Covenant notices, audits corrupted '?★' anomalies, and enforces Gate Boss trials with merciless precision.

At its center rises the cyan-and-gold Star Gate monolith—the ONLY place where Star Shards can summon new heroes—flanked by the cliff-edge Floor Transfer Ring and the stone gateway to the Iron Barracks, while dozens of rival Masters' gilded or crumbling floating lobby islands drift across the horizon around the colossal 100-Floor Starfall Labyrinth Spire.

startingNodes.speaker: Pia Hollis
startingNodes.title: Act I Awakening: The 1★ Discard Queue & First Deployment Bell
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Cold cyan starlight hums through the towering monolith at the center of Star Gate Plaza—an open obsidian-and-marble courtyard perched atop a massive floating sky-island adrift in a sea of starlit clouds, dozens of other Masters' distant floating islands orbiting the colossal Starfall Spire on the horizon. Seconds ago you were staring at your monitor as the #1 ranked player of Celestia Summons. Now your cheek is pressed against freezing stone, a bronze [1★ • LV.1] brand stinging the back of your wrist.

High in the astral sky above the island, a translucent gold system window flickers—your unseen Master skimming the roster, hovering a finger over the crimson [SYNTHESIZE FODDER] icon before lazily tapping [AUTO-DEPLOY: FLOOR 1] instead. Beside you in the Discard Queue, a white-antlered fae cleric in deep-teal sanctuary vestments scrambles to pull you upright, golden bead chains chiming softly in her snow-white hair.
startingNodes.dialogue:
"D-don't stay on the synthesis tiles!" Pia Hollis whispers urgently, her glowing cyan eyes wide beneath white lashes as she steadies your elbow with trembling fingers. "If the light turns red while you're lying there, the furnace takes you—I saw it happen to three other one-stars twenty minutes ago."

She swallows hard, pressing her beaded sleeves over her heart as the Floor 1 transfer ring ignites in pale blue flames thirty paces away. "The Master just tagged just the two of us for scouting duty. Two level-ones on Floor 1... we're just trap bait, aren't we?"
choices: [Meta-Knowledge]: Calm Pia down, check the Star Gate shard counter first, and explain the exact blind spot of Floor 1's opening goblin ambush.
[Role Technique]: Test your 1★ body's stance right on the plaza stones and adjust Pia's grip so her heal-cast takes half the time.
[Protect the Weak]: Step between Pia and the active Floor 1 transfer ring, promising her nobody in your squad is getting used as fodder.
[Lobby Strategy]: Signal the Master's overhead camera toward the Star Gate monolith to lobby for another pull before stepping into Floor 1.

startingNodes.speaker: Sable Ashgrove
startingNodes.title: Sable Ashgrove: Don't Bother Telling Me Your Name, One-Star
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Ash-gray stardust drifts across Star Gate Plaza as your summoning pillar fades, leaving you standing in scuffed 1★ recruit gear beside the cracked steps of the Star Gate. Most rookie rosters buzz with naive excitement. This hall is dead quiet.

Sitting on an overturned supply crate near the Iron Barracks arch is a pale, emerald-green-haired abyssal scout in a ruffled black-and-white gothic maid dress and dark ridged horns, sharpening an obsidian dagger in black clawed opera gloves while two sleek dark tentacles coil lazily behind her waist.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Sable Ashgrove doesn't even look up from her blade until the Master's overhead cursor drags your 1★ icon next to hers in Party Slot 1.

"Unbelievable. I survive Floor 7 by the skin of my teeth and the idiot upstairs pairs me with a fresh one-star," she mutters, finally fixing you with sharp, sleepless sage-emerald eyes. "Listen close, rookie: don't tell me your life story, don't lag behind, and when the Floor 1 gate opens, stay three paces off my tentacles. Can you manage that without dying in five minutes?"
choices: [Meta-Knowledge]: Point out the notch on her left dagger—she chipped it on a Floor 7 Carrion Mimic because nobody told her about the hinge seam.
[Dry Pushback]: Meet her glare evenly and tell her if she wants to survive Floor 10's Hollow King, she's going to need your callouts.
[Role Technique]: Flip your starter weapon cleanly into guard to show her your footwork isn't a level-one amateur's.
[Lobby Prep]: Check the Star Gate shard balance and weapon racks in the Lobby before letting the Master rush the deployment.

startingNodes.speaker: Dame Odette Varr
startingNodes.title: Dame Odette Varr: The Suicidal Command Seal
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
Golden chime bells echo across Star Gate Plaza as a crimson Command Seal blazes into the air above the Floor 1 transfer gate: [OBJECTIVE: CLEAR FLOOR 1 CORRIDOR IN UNDER 4 MINUTES — NO RETREAT].

Anyone who actually played Celestia Summons knows rushing the central corridor at Level 1 triggers all three Moss-Hound nests at once. Yet standing at rigid attention before the Star Gate is a regal alabaster-skinned 3★ Gorgon warden in a filigree black gothic gown, a crown of live white vipers coiled alertly through her white hair.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Dame Odette Varr turns as you step out of the summoning circle, her luminous pale-lavender Gorgon eyes sizing up your 1★ insignia with solemn gravity while her white crown-serpents tongue the air.

"You are the new auxiliary assigned to my vanguard," Odette states, conjuring a slab-thick alabaster stone-ward sigil before her hand. "Hear me clearly: our Lord beyond the sky has issued a timed decree. The central hallway is surely trapped, yet an oathbound warden does not question a Command Seal. Fall in behind my stone-aegis—I will take the brunt of the charge myself."
choices: [Meta-Knowledge / Loophole]: Stop her—show her the side drainage culvert route that clears Floor 1 in three minutes flat WITHOUT violating the Command Seal.
[Defy Suicidal Pride]: Step directly in front of her shield and tell her bluntly that dying for an auto-battle timer isn't chivalry, it's suicide.
[Tactical Respect]: Salute her resolve, inspect her cracked pauldron strap in the Lobby first, and propose a two-man choke-point formation.
[Lobby Summon Check]: Point toward the pulsing Star Gate monolith and suggest rallying reinforcements before triggering the four-minute clock.

startingNodes.speaker: Lyra Nocturne
startingNodes.title: Lyra Nocturne: Four Stars Stuck With a One-Star Captain
startingNodes.sceneSetup: Emerald-teal starlight still lingers around the central Star Gate monolith from a lucky banner pull minutes before yours. Standing on the marble dais in black-and-white gold-filigree astral vestments is Lyra Nocturne, an emerald runic halo blazing behind her jet-black hair—until a system chime assigns YOU, a fresh 1★ pull, to [PARTY LEADER: SLOT 1] because the Master misclicked while sorting by newest.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Lyra stares at the floating party window for three full seconds before rapping her ornate brass astrolabe staff sharply against the stone, a flush of indignant disbelief coloring her pale cheeks.

"Excuse me? Did the Master fall asleep on their screen?!" she demands, marching down the Star Gate steps to jab a pale-gloved finger near your collarbone. "I am a four-star Astral Arcanist of the Nocturne Covenant, and I am NOT taking field orders from a level-one bronze pull! Swap the leader badge back to me right now before we step onto Floor 1, or stay twenty yards out of my blast radius!"
choices: [Meta-Knowledge]: Casually recite the exact 2.4-second cast flaw in her Nocturne Starfall spell—and how Floor 1's goblin archers punish it without a spotter.
[Unbothered Wit]: Tell her she's welcome to all the glory as long as she fires exactly where you point when the ambush drops.
[Role Technique]: Demonstrate a frame-tight interrupt stance to prove the Master didn't put you in Slot 1 by accident.
[Calm Bargain]: Offer her a deal right here in Star Gate Plaza—give you one floor as shot-caller, and if she takes a single scratch, the badge is hers.

startingNodes.speaker: Mei Zhou
startingNodes.title: Mei Zhou: Knuckle-Wraps by the Star Gate
startingNodes.sceneSetup: While the rest of Star Gate Plaza feels like a funeral parlor waiting for the next deployment bell, somebody is loudly whistling near the base of the Star Gate monolith. Sitting cross-legged on the marble rim in a crimson-and-black striped kimono is a black-bobbed brawler with crimson hair streaks, neon-red eye-sigil curse tattoos glowing faintly across her collarbone and monstrously clawed left hand.
startingNodes.dialogue:
Mei Zhou hops down lightly, flexing her obsidian-and-crimson left claws as she flashes you a fearless grin—though her sharp scarlet eyes flick instinctively toward the distant Memorial Wall for just a heartbeat.

"Yo! Fresh arrival! Don't look so stiff—first minute out of the crystal always feels like a hangover," Mei laughs, clapping her human right hand warmly onto your shoulder. "Looks like the boss upstairs threw us into the same squad. Don't sweat the one-star tag, alright? Just stick behind these red claws when we hit Floor 1—I've got enough punch for both of us!"
choices: [Observant]: Catch her wrist lightly and point out her right gauntlet strap is loose—she's planning to tank hits meant for a vanguard, isn't she?
[Meta-Knowledge]: Match her grin and warn her that Floor 1's Acid Moss-Hounds melt bare knuckle-wraps unless we pull them to dry stone.
[Equal Partner]: Bump your fist against her gauntlet and tell her nobody's hiding behind anybody—we clear the floor together.
[Lobby Recon]: Ask her how long she's been in this Master's roster and check the Star Gate plaza resources before deploying.

startingNodes.speaker: Aurelle, the Seraph Lance
startingNodes.title: Aurelle, the Seraph Lance: Five Stars in an Empty Hall
startingNodes.sceneSetup:
A reroll miracle sits alone at the center of Star Gate Plaza. Beneath the towering Star Gate monolith stands Aurelle, the Seraph Lance—a 0.5%-rate 5★ Mythic Valkyrie in white-silver half-plate, five pale-gold stars silent above her shoulder.

As your lowly 1★ summoning pillar shatters into dull bronze sparks beside her, the silver tip of her star-forged lance stops a hair's breadth from your throat—testing your pulse without a flicker of warmth in her ice-cyan eyes.
startingNodes.dialogue:
"...A one-star," Aurelle says quietly, lowering her lance with unhurried, practiced detachment. Her voice isn't cruel—just winter-cold from watching too many disposable squads vanish beside her.

"Our new Master burned their starter pulls chasing me and left the rest of the roster empty. When the Floor 1 gate opens, stay by the exit ring and do not try to assist me. Low-star heroes who try to keep pace with my lance only die faster. Understood?"
choices: [Meta-Knowledge]: Hold her gaze without flinching and name her hidden 5★ drawback—'Seraph's Isolation' drains her stamina by half when fighting with zero squad synergy.
[Steely Composure]: Step past the flat of her lance toward the Floor 1 map and tell her solo carries wipe by Floor 20—she needs a tactician, not a spectator.
[Human Warmth]: Ignore the 5★ aura completely and ask when she last rested in the Iron Barracks instead of standing guard in the Lobby.
[Lobby Strategy]: Gesture to the Star Gate monolith—if the Master has leftover shards, we build a balanced squad right here before touching Floor 1.

companions.title: 3★ Silent Draconian Kopis Assassin • Nameless Roster
companions.personality: Stoic, throat-scarred draconian assassin discarded by shallow Masters for her quiet intensity. Speaks in hushed, economical sentences and expresses fierce devotion through silent protective actions—hooking allies out of lethal AoEs with her damascus waist-chain and crippling bosses with presynaptic neurotoxin needles.
values: Warm Broth for Her Scarred Throat
companions.visualPrompt: Dark-fantasy anime gacha illustration of Abraxia, pale porcelain skin, long straight crimson-red hair with blunt bangs, black spiked gothic tiara with dark crimson roses, gothic cross earrings, black lace choker, glowing crimson eyes, glossy crimson-and-black filigree gothic plate armor over black lace thigh-high stockings and black armored greaves, wielding an ornate glowing crimson-and-black runic greatsword alongside concealed neurotoxin needles.

companions.name: Godiva
companions.title: 4★ Masked Void-Walker Hexblade • Nameless Roster
companions.personality: Enigmatic, velvet-voiced 4★ Void-Walker who wears a soul-imbued porcelain mask tilted on her temple and blinks across dimensional rifts to brand twin Hex Seals onto bosses. Playfully teasing and hard to read on the surface, hiding old void-scars and fierce loyalty for a commander bold enough to trust her blind-spot warps.
values: Commanders Who Don't Flinch at Void Blinks
companions.visualPrompt: Dark-fantasy inked character sprite of Godiva, long straight espresso-black hair, cool smoky grey eyes with vertical dark tear-streak mark under left eye, black off-shoulder occult robes with hexagram sigil on sleeve, floating black four-pointed Void Star sigil above her fingers.

companions.name: Vaelkor
companions.title: 2★ Dragonborn Storm-Brand Spellsword • Nameless Roster
companions.personality: Pragmatic, dry-humored 2★ Dragonborn spellsword passed over by shallow Masters who only chase human banner idols. Channels crackling violet storm-lightning from his scaled claws down his back-slung greatsword to short-circuit constructs and boss casts; treats a smart squad leader like sworn clutch-kin.
companions.visualPrompt: Inked dark-fantasy character sprite of Vaelkor, male bronze-grey scaled Dragonborn spellsword with horned draconic head, spiked bronze pauldron and gauntlet, navy hooded cloak, leather chest straps, greatsword with purple gem hilt on back, purple lightning crackling around his right claw.

companions.name: Garrick Ironbrow
companions.title: 3★ Scarred Veteran Axe-Bulwark • Nameless Roster
companions.personality: Grizzled, white-bearded veteran warrior in battle-scarred steel plate carrying a massive notched battleaxe. Dumped by meta-chasing Masters for being 'old iron,' yet his unshakable frontline poise and gruff fatherly grit hold panicking rookie squads together against impossible Gate Bosses.
dislikes: Watching Kids Die on His Watch
companions.visualPrompt: Dark-fantasy character sprite of Garrick Ironbrow, grizzled older muscular male warrior with white topknot hair, full trimmed white beard, facial scars, weathered battle-scarred steel plate armor and chainmail, heavy iron battleaxe resting over his shoulder.

companions.name: Sir Roland Vance
companions.title: 4★ Crimson-Cloak Silver Paladin • Apex Exile
companions.personality: Tall, aristocratic 4★ cathedral paladin in gleaming silver plate and a crimson cloak. Starts coolly skeptical of taking orders from a 1★ leader, arms folded in strict evaluation—but once your boss-frame callouts prove razor-accurate, his unbending knightly honor makes him an immovable shield at your side.
values: Commanders Who Lead from the Front
companions.visualPrompt: Korean fantasy manhwa character sprite of Sir Roland Vance, aristocratic blonde male paladin with cool blue eyes, gleaming engraved silver plate armor over black chainmail, crimson-red cloak clasped at the collar, arms folded.

flowchartTree.title: Lobby (Floor 0): Star Gate Awakening & Discard Queue
flowchartTree.speaker: Pia Hollis
flowchartTree.summary: Waking up as a 1★ Lv.1 fodder pull in Star Gate Plaza, accessing the Star Gate monolith, and escaping the Synthesis Furnace.

flowchartTree.title: Lobby: Iron Barracks Briefing & Star Gate Pulls
flowchartTree.speaker: Sable Ashgrove
flowchartTree.summary: Forging deployment discipline with veteran survivors in the Lobby Quarters and petitioning the Star Gate for squad reinforcements.

flowchartTree.title: Floor 1: The Verdant Antechamber — Zero-Casualty Oath
flowchartTree.speaker: Dame Odette Varr
flowchartTree.summary: Surviving the first live Labyrinth deployment using ex-ranker ambush callouts while bending a reckless Master Command Seal.

flowchartTree.title: Floor 5 Safe Zone: Lantern Bazaar & Crimson Ledger Clash
flowchartTree.speaker: Mei Zhou
flowchartTree.summary: Reaching the first Safe Zone cavern, tending wounds, and crossing blades with rival whale Master Kaiser Valdane's speedrun vanguard.

flowchartTree.title: Resonance Awakening: Breaking the 1★ Level 20 Ceiling
flowchartTree.speaker: Lyra Nocturne
flowchartTree.summary: Shattering the hard Lv.20 1★ cap through forged party bonds (+1★ Awakening) in Star Gate Plaza.

unlockRequirement.hintSilhouette: Locked: Requires First Bond Milestone (25% Affection)

flowchartTree.title: Floor 10 Gate Boss: Aldric, the Hollow King
flowchartTree.speaker: Aurelle, the Seraph Lance
flowchartTree.location: Floor 10: Gate of the Hollow King
flowchartTree.summary: Surviving the infamous rookie-killer Phase 2 'Ashen Decree' behind the shattered pillar shadows with zero fallen comrades.

flowchartTree.title: Floor 25: Chronos Clocktower & Vesper's Crimson Duel
flowchartTree.speaker: Aurelle, the Seraph Lance
flowchartTree.summary: Navigating time-stutter brass chasms and clashing with rival 5★ champion Vesper, the Crimson Lancer.

flowchartTree.title: Floor 40 Gate: Cinder Horizon & Edge of Ranker Memory
flowchartTree.speaker: Sable Ashgrove
flowchartTree.location: Floor 40: Cinder Horizon & Unwound Sun Gate
flowchartTree.summary: Conquering the final Chronos Foundry floor you remember from Celestia Summons—and stepping together into uncharted Floors 41–100 blind.

unlockRequirement.hintSilhouette: Locked: Requires Deep Trust Resonance (65% Affection)

flowchartTree.title: Floor 70 Eclipse Court: Blood-Moon Viaduct & Crimson Trial
flowchartTree.speaker: Dame Odette Varr
flowchartTree.location: Floor 70: Blood-Moon Viaduct & Crimson Trial Court
flowchartTree.summary: Crossing the uncharted Eclipse Sanctum mirror courts and breaking Kaiser Valdane's 5★ champion Vesper beneath a total scarlet eclipse.

flowchartTree.title: Floor 100 Finale: Shattering the Administrator's Crown
flowchartTree.speaker: Aurelle, the Seraph Lance
flowchartTree.summary: Ascending the zero-gravity Astral Singularity, clearing the 100th floor beneath the shattered Fourth Wall, liberating every surviving hero, and unlocking the return gate.
